title: Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan Appointment to Federal Posts Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan Appointment to Federal Posts Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
EX‑EMPLOYEES OF THE FORMER GOVERNMENT OF EAST
PAKISTAN (APPOINTMENT TO FEDERAL POSTS) ORDINANCE, 1983
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Ex‑Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan
(Appointment to Federal Posts) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the sixteenth day of December,
1971.

sections.shortTitle: Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan Appointment to Federal Posts Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
EX‑EMPLOYEES OF THE FORMER GOVERNMENT OF EAST
PAKISTAN (APPOINTMENT TO FEDERAL POSTS) ORDINANCE, 1983
2. Definitions.‑In this Ordinance, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "employee" means an employee of the former Government
of East Pakistan who was repatriated or who migrated from East Pakistan to
Pakistan during the period commencing on the 16th December, 1971, and ending on
the 31st December, 1974, in consequence of occupation of the territory by enemy
troops or establishment of Bangladesh ;
(b) "former post"
means the post which was held by an employee at the time of his repatriation or
migration to Pakistan;
(c) "Grade" means the
Grade of the National Pay Scale in which a post or group of posts is placed;
and
(d) "post" means a post in an All‑Pakistan Service
or a service of the Federation or a post in connection with the affairs of the
Federation.

sections.shortTitle: Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan Appointment to Federal Posts Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Appointment

ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
EX‑EMPLOYEES OF THE FORMER GOVERNMENT OF EAST
PAKISTAN (APPOINTMENT TO FEDERAL POSTS) ORDINANCE, 1983
3. Appointment.‑‑An
employee may, with the approval of the competent Authority, be appointed to an
existing or supernumerary post in the Grade. as far as practicable, equivalent ‑to
the scale of the former post of such employee from the date he holds such post.
Explanation.‑In this section, "competent authority"
in relation to a post, means the authority competent under the Civil Servants
Act, 1973 (LXXI of 1973), to make appointment to that post.

sections.shortTitle: Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan Appointment to Federal Posts Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Seniority

ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
EX‑EMPLOYEES OF THE FORMER GOVERNMENT OF EAST
PAKISTAN (APPOINTMENT TO FEDERAL POSTS) ORDINANCE, 1983
4. Seniority.‑The service
rendered under the former Government of East Pakistan by an employee shall
count towards seniority in the Grade of the post to which he may be appointed
under section 3.
